m: The **royal court** in its **palace courtyard**: the **imperial court**.
ex: 朝廷派人来调查。
The imperial court sent people to investigate.
这件事很快就传到了朝廷。
News of this soon reached the imperial court.
use: Historical word, used in stories and dramas about old China.

m: Put it on the **surface** and make it **bright**: you **make it clear**.
ex: 他表明了自己的态度。
He made his position clear.
调查表明，很多人每天都喝咖啡。
The survey shows that many people drink coffee every day.
use: Often with 态度 (attitude) or 立场 (position); also "research shows" in reports.

m: The **chief** **person** **entrusted** with a job: the **head of a committee**.
ex: 委员长在会上讲了话。
The committee chairman spoke at the meeting.
他当了十年的委员长。
He served as chairman of the committee for ten years.
use: Formal title; used for heads of committees such as the NPC Standing Committee.

m: The **owner** **holds** the event together: he **takes charge** of it.
ex: 今天的会议由王老师主持。
Today's meeting is chaired by Mr Wang.
她在电视台主持一个节目。
She hosts a programme at the TV station.
use: Used for chairing meetings and hosting shows; the host is 主持人.

ex: 我常常在这家店买面包。
I often buy bread at this shop.
他小时候常常生病。
He was often ill when he was little.
use: Spoken and common; 经常 is a close equal. The negative is 不常, not 不常常.

m: **Encounter** something and **reach** it: you **run into** it.
ex: 我在路上遇到了一个老朋友。
I ran into an old friend on the way.
遇到问题，你可以问我。
If you run into problems, you can ask me.
use: Goes with people and with problems or difficulties (困难).

m: It **exists** **in** this point: the answer **lies in** it.
ex: 问题在于我们没有时间。
The problem is that we don't have time.
成功的关键在于坚持。
The key to success lies in persistence.
use: Formal; usually follows 问题, 关键 or 原因 and is followed by the cause.

ex: 年轻人越来越喜欢网上消费。
Young people increasingly like to shop online.
这个城市的消费水平很高。
The cost of living in this city is high.
use: Economic word for spending; 消费者 is "consumer".

ex: 欢迎你来我家玩！
You're welcome to come and visit my home!
这本书很受学生欢迎。
This book is very popular with students.
use: 受欢迎 means "popular".

m: A **thought** **rises** in your mind: you **recall** it.
ex: 我想起来了，他姓李。
Now I remember, his surname is Li.
看到这张照片，我想起了小时候。
Seeing this photo, I think of my childhood.
use: Often 想起来; 想不起来 means "can't remember".

m: One **sun** across the sky is one **day**.
ex: 今天是个好日子。
Today is a good day.
他们的日子过得越来越好。
Their life is getting better and better.
use: Also means "life, livelihood" in 过日子.

m: A **strip** of paper where nations **make an appointment**: a **treaty**.
ex: 两国签订了和平条约。
The two countries signed a peace treaty.
这个条约是一百年前签的。
This treaty was signed a hundred years ago.
use: Between countries; goes with 签订 (to sign). Measure word 项 or 个.

ex: 双方终于达成了协议。
The two sides finally reached an agreement.
我们签了一份三年的协议。
We signed a three-year agreement.
use: Goes with 达成 (reach) and 签 (sign). Measure word 份 or 项.

ex: 这件事已经公开了。
This matter has already been made public.
他们公开表示反对。
They openly expressed opposition.
use: Opposite of 秘密 (secret).

m: Areas **delimited** by **political** rule so things **walk** smoothly: **administrative divisions**.
ex: 中国的行政区划分为省、市、县等。
China's administrative divisions include provinces, cities and counties.
这个地区的行政区划变了好几次。
The administrative divisions of this region have changed several times.
use: Formal, used in geography and government texts.

ex: 这条路限制速度。
This road has a speed limit.
每人只能买两个，这是公司的限制。
Each person can buy only two; that's the company's limit.
use: Often 受到限制 (to be restricted); 不受限制 means "unlimited".

ex: 梦想和现实往往不一样。
Dreams and reality are often different.
你的计划不太现实。
Your plan isn't very realistic.
use: As an adjective it means "realistic, practical".

ex: 我住在武昌。
I live in Wuchang.
从汉口坐地铁到武昌很方便。
It's easy to take the subway from Hankou to Wuchang.
use: One of the three old towns that make up Wuhan.

ex: 中午的阳光很强烈。
The midday sunlight is very strong.
大家强烈要求改变这个规定。
Everyone strongly demanded that the rule be changed.
use: Goes with feelings, demands, sunlight; often used as an adverb before verbs.

ex: 他早已离开了北京。
He left Beijing long ago.
这些我早已知道了。
I knew all this long ago.
use: More written than 早就.

ex: 明天下雨的话，我们就不去了。
If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.
你有时间的话，来我家吃饭吧。
If you have time, come to my place for dinner.
use: Comes at the end of the condition; often paired with 如果 at the start.

ex: 我去商店买了两件衣服。
I went to the shop and bought two items of clothing.
你的衣服真漂亮！
Your clothes are really pretty!
use: Measure word 件 for tops, 套 for a set.

m: The **highest** **positive** light in the sky: the **sun**.
ex: 太阳出来了。
The sun has come out.
今天太阳很大，记得戴帽子。
The sun is strong today, remember to wear a hat.
use: 晒太阳 means "to sit in the sun".

m: **River** **south**: south of the Yellow River, **Henan** province.
ex: 我的老家在河南。
My hometown is in Henan.
河南是中国人口很多的一个省。
Henan is one of China's most populous provinces.
use: Short name 豫. Capital is 郑州.

ex: 这里有广大的农村。
There are vast rural areas here.
这个活动受到广大学生的欢迎。
This event was welcomed by students everywhere.
use: Often 广大群众 / 广大人民: "the broad masses", a formal phrase.

m: **Straight** in the middle of it, **existing** now: **in the process of** doing.
ex: 我正在吃饭。
I'm eating right now.
他们正在开会，请等一下。
They're in a meeting at the moment, please wait.
use: Before a verb, often with 呢 at the end: 我正在看书呢。

ex: 那个胖子跑得很快。
That fat guy runs very fast.
他小时候是个小胖子。
He was a chubby little boy as a child.
use: Can be rude about adults; 小胖子 is affectionate for children.

m: The way you **pass** through life shows your **attitude**.
ex: 他的工作态度很好。
He has a good attitude to work.
服务员的态度不太好。
The waiter's manner wasn't very good.
use: Goes with 好 / 不好, 认真; 表明态度 means "state one's position".

ex: 这个菜味道不好。
This dish doesn't taste good.
对不起，我今天身体不好。
Sorry, I'm not feeling well today.
use: 不好意思 means "sorry, embarrassed".

ex: 我们经常用中文交流。
We often communicate in Chinese.
两国的文化交流越来越多。
Cultural exchanges between the two countries are increasing.
use: Used for communicating ideas, culture or experience; often 和…交流.

ex: 前面有一家银行。
There is a bank up ahead.
请坐在我前面。
Please sit in front of me.
use: Opposite of 后面; also means "earlier, above" in a text.

ex: 这片森林很大。
This forest is very big.
周末我们去森林里走走吧。
Let's go for a walk in the forest at the weekend.
use: Measure word 片.

ex: 他显然不高兴。
He is obviously unhappy.
显然，这个办法行不通。
Clearly, this method won't work.
use: Can start a sentence; similar to 明显 but more of a sentence adverb.

ex: 最近天气有所好转。
The weather has improved somewhat recently.
大家的成绩都有所提高。
Everyone's results have improved to some extent.
use: Formal; followed by a two-syllable verb like 提高, 改变, 不同.

m: A **king** who **rushes** about: the **Roaming King**, rebel leader Li Zicheng.
ex: 闯王李自成进了北京。
The Roaming King, Li Zicheng, entered Beijing.
很多故事都讲到闯王。
Many stories tell of the Roaming King.
use: Historical nickname, mostly Li Zicheng, who ended the Ming dynasty.

ex: 我只看了一部分。
I only watched part of it.
一部分学生已经回家了。
Some of the students have already gone home.
use: Often 一部分人: "some people". Compare 大部分 "most".

ex: 公司撤销了这个决定。
The company revoked this decision.
他的驾驶证被撤销了。
His driving licence was revoked.
use: Formal; used for orders, decisions, licences, posts.

ex: 学校离我家三千米。
The school is three kilometres from my home.
他每天跑五千米。
He runs five kilometres every day.
use: 公里 is the more common everyday word.

ex: 大风破坏了很多房子。
The strong wind damaged many houses.
我们要保护环境，不要破坏它。
We should protect the environment, not destroy it.
use: Goes with 环境, 关系, 规定; stronger than 弄坏.

ex: 他用双手接过了礼物。
He took the gift with both hands.
请把双手放在桌子上。
Please put both hands on the table.
use: Using both hands to give or take is polite in China.

m: **South** of the **river** Yangtze: **Jiangnan**, the lower Yangtze region.
ex: 江南的春天很美。
Spring in Jiangnan is beautiful.
苏州是一个典型的江南城市。
Suzhou is a typical Jiangnan city.
use: Suggests water towns, rain and rice; often used in poetry.

ex: 我每天晚上阅读半小时。
I read for half an hour every evening.
阅读可以让人学到很多东西。
Reading can teach people a lot.
use: More formal than 看书 or 读; common on exams (阅读理解).

ex: 书在桌子上面。
The book is on the table.
上面说的问题，我们明天再讨论。
We'll discuss the problems mentioned above tomorrow.
use: Also refers to higher authorities: 上面来人了.

ex: 他的工资不高。
His wages aren't high.
公司每个月十号发工资。
The company pays wages on the tenth of every month.
use: 发工资 (pay wages), 涨工资 (get a raise).

ex: 大家纷纷表示同意。
One after another, everyone said they agreed.
下课了，学生们纷纷走出教室。
Class was over and the students streamed out of the room.
use: Describes many people doing the same thing; not used with a single person.

ex: 我住在城市的北部。
I live in the north of the city.
中国北部冬天很冷。
Northern China is very cold in winter.
use: Also 南部, 东部, 西部.

ex: 这家店的水果种类很多。
This shop has many kinds of fruit.
这两种动物属于不同的种类。
These two animals belong to different types.
use: Often 种类很多 / 种类不同.

ex: 无论多忙，他都会给妈妈打电话。
No matter how busy he is, he always calls his mother.
无论你去不去，我都去。
Whether you go or not, I'm going.
use: Paired with 都 or 也 in the second part; like 不管, but more formal.

ex: 我们需要深入了解这个问题。
We need to understand this problem thoroughly.
他深入农村做调查。
He went deep into the countryside to do research.
use: Goes with 了解, 研究, 讨论.

ex: 公司正在推进这个计划。
The company is pushing this plan forward.
工作推进得很顺利。
The work is progressing smoothly.
use: Formal; goes with 工作, 改革, 计划.

ex: 这个国家有很多石油。
This country has a lot of oil.
石油的价格又上涨了。
The price of oil has gone up again.
use: Crude oil; cooking oil is 食用油, petrol is 汽油.

ex: 外面太冷了，我们进去吧。
It's too cold out here, let's go in.
门开着，你直接进去吧。
The door's open, just go straight in.
use: Movement away from the speaker; 进来 is toward the speaker.

m: **Up** on the **earth**: **on the ground**, **on the floor**.
ex: 你的书掉在地上了。
Your book fell on the floor.
地上有很多水，小心！
There's a lot of water on the floor, be careful!
use: In 地上, 上 is light-toned; 地下 means "underground" or "on the floor" in speech.

ex: 这个药的效果很好。
This medicine works very well.
我们试了很多办法，可是效果不大。
We tried many ways, but they had little effect.
use: Often 效果好 / 效果不好 / 有效果.

m: A **round** circle of people forming one **body**: a **group**.
ex: 我们是一个旅游团体。
We are a tour group.
他参加了好几个学生团体。
He has joined several student organisations.
use: Organised group or society; 集体 stresses "collective".

ex: 倘若明天下雨，比赛就取消。
If it rains tomorrow, the match will be cancelled.
倘若你有困难，就告诉我。
If you have any difficulties, just tell me.
use: Written and formal; 如果 is the everyday word.

ex: 她看起来很年轻。
She looks very young.
年轻人应该多出去看看。
Young people should go out and see more of the world.
use: 年轻人 means "young people".

m: The **pit** at the **heart** of the fruit: the **core**.
ex: 他是我们队的核心。
He is the core of our team.
这个问题的核心是钱。
The heart of this problem is money.
use: Often 核心问题, 核心技术.

ex: 我们晚上去看电影吧。
Let's go and see a film tonight.
这部电影讲的是一个爱情故事。
This film is about a love story.
use: Measure word 部; cinema is 电影院.

ex: 这个城市的纺织工业很发达。
This city's textile industry is well developed.
她以前在纺织厂工作。
She used to work in a textile mill.
use: Mostly in 纺织业, 纺织品, 纺织厂.

m: An **elephant's** **appearance** sticks in the mind: an **image**.
ex: 这件事影响了公司的形象。
This affected the company's image.
他说话很形象。
He speaks very vividly.
use: As an adjective it means "vivid".

ex: 天气预报说下雨，果然下雨了。
The forecast said rain, and sure enough it rained.
他果然没来。
Sure enough, he didn't come.
use: Something happens as expected; compare 竟然 "unexpectedly".

ex: 我意识到自己错了。
I realised I was wrong.
他的安全意识很强。
He has a strong sense of safety.
use: As a verb usually 意识到 (to realise).

ex: 他是公司的常务副总。
He is the company's executive vice president.
常务会议每周开一次。
The standing meeting is held once a week.
use: Mostly in titles: 常务委员, 常务副市长.

ex: 他的生活很有规律。
He leads a very regular life.
我们要找出其中的规律。
We need to find the pattern in it.
use: 有规律 means "regular"; natural law is 自然规律.

ex: 她今天显得很高兴。
She seems very happy today.
这件衣服让你显得更年轻。
These clothes make you look younger.
use: Followed by an adjective; stresses how something comes across.

ex: 人人平等。
Everyone is equal.
男女应该享有平等的权利。
Men and women should have equal rights.
use: Opposite 不平等.

m: **Mountains** to the **east**: east of the Taihang mountains, **Shandong** province.
ex: 我的朋友是山东人。
My friend is from Shandong.
山东的饺子很有名。
Shandong's dumplings are well known.
use: Short name 鲁; capital is 济南.

ex: 这些水果要加工成果汁。
These fruits will be processed into juice.
这家工厂做食品加工。
This factory does food processing.
use: Used for materials and food; 加工厂 is a processing plant.

ex: 我只是问一下。
I'm just asking.
这件衣服很好看，只是太贵了。
This garment looks nice, it's just too expensive.
use: Also "but, only that" to add a small objection.

ex: 武汉大学在洪山区。
Wuhan University is in Hongshan District.
我家住在洪山区。
My family lives in Hongshan District.
use: A district name; 区 means district.

ex: 马路两侧有很多树。
There are many trees on both sides of the road.
门的两侧各站着一个人。
A person stands on each side of the door.
use: More written than 两边.

ex: 这里被列为世界遗产。
This place has been listed as a World Heritage site.
这个问题被列为今年的工作重点。
This issue has been made a key task for this year.
use: Often with 被: 被列为…; formal.

ex: 欢迎你加入我们！
Welcome to our team!
他去年加入了一个足球俱乐部。
He joined a football club last year.
use: Join a group or organisation; also add an ingredient: 加入一点盐.

ex: 大部分人都同意。
Most people agree.
我的大部分时间都在学习。
I spend most of my time studying.
use: Compare 一部分 "part"; 大多数 is close in meaning.

ex: 一九四九年，这个城市解放了。
In 1949 this city was liberated.
考完试了，我终于解放了！
The exam is over, I'm finally free!
use: In China often refers to 1949; jokingly "free at last".

ex: 这条新闻是新华社发的。
This news was released by Xinhua News Agency.
新华社记者在现场采访。
Xinhua reporters are interviewing at the scene.
use: China's official state news agency.

ex: 天气逐步变暖了。
The weather has gradually got warmer.
我们会逐步解决这些问题。
We will solve these problems step by step.
use: Formal; close to 逐渐, but 逐步 stresses planned steps.

ex: 别担心，我没事。
Don't worry, I'm fine.
妈妈很担心你的身体。
Mum is very worried about your health.
use: Takes an object directly: 担心他, 担心考试.

ex: 气温下降了五度。
The temperature dropped by five degrees.
最近他的成绩有点下降。
His grades have dropped a bit recently.
use: Opposite 上升; used for numbers, levels, prices.

ex: 桌子表面很光滑。
The table's surface is very smooth.
他表面上很平静，其实很紧张。
On the surface he's calm, but in fact he's nervous.
use: 表面上 means "outwardly, seemingly".

ex: 我晚上常常看电视。
I often watch TV in the evening.
我家买了一台新电视。
My family bought a new TV.
use: Measure word 台; 看电视 is "watch TV".

ex: 你有修车的工具吗？
Do you have tools for fixing the car?
语言是交流的工具。
Language is a tool for communication.
use: Measure word 件 or 个; 交通工具 means "means of transport".

ex: 你可以在这个网站上买票。
You can buy tickets on this website.
我们公司的网站上周更新了。
Our company's website was updated last week.
use: Measure word 个; 在网站上 means "on a website".

ex: 这个蛋糕是我自己制作的。
I made this cake myself.
这部电影制作得很好。
This film is very well made.
use: More formal than 做; used for films, programmes, handicrafts.

ex: 这家酒店的设施很新。
This hotel's facilities are very new.
学校的体育设施不太好。
The school's sports facilities aren't very good.
use: Often 公共设施, 体育设施.

m: The **heavenly** **ford**: **Tianjin**, a big port city near Beijing.
ex: 我坐高铁去天津。
I'm taking the high-speed train to Tianjin.
天津离北京只有半个小时。
Tianjin is only half an hour from Beijing.
use: Short name 津; 津 here means "ford, crossing".

ex: 这是我们一年工作的成果。
This is the result of a year of our work.
他的研究取得了很大成果。
His research has achieved great results.
use: Positive results only; goes with 取得.

ex: 我们的预算不多。
We don't have much budget.
这次旅行你预算了多少钱？
How much have you budgeted for this trip?
use: Over budget is 超出预算.

ex: 这个国家的经济被几个寡头控制。
The country's economy is controlled by a few oligarchs.
那个寡头买下了一家报社。
That oligarch bought a newspaper.
use: Formal, used in news and economics.

ex: 考试前我很紧张。
I was very nervous before the exam.
最近工作很紧张，没有时间休息。
Work has been very intense lately, no time to rest.
use: Also "tense, in short supply": 时间紧张.

ex: 我的手机没电了。
My phone's battery is dead.
你的手机号码是多少？
What's your mobile number?
use: Measure word 部 or 个; 玩手机 means "be on your phone".

ex: 政府采取了一系列措施。
The government took a series of measures.
最近发生了一系列的问题。
A string of problems has happened recently.
use: Followed by a noun, often with 的; formal.

ex: 这个家族的势力很大。
This family has great influence.
他想扩大自己的势力。
He wants to expand his power.
use: Often negative: 黑社会势力, 外国势力.

m: **Record** it and **carry** it down the years: **write down**.
ex: 这本书记载了很多历史故事。
This book records many historical stories.
根据记载，这座桥有五百年了。
According to the records, this bridge is five hundred years old.
use: Used for historical records; formal.

ex: 他在外交部工作。
He works at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
两国建立了外交关系。
The two countries established diplomatic relations.
use: 外交官 is "diplomat".

ex: 我常常在搜狐上看新闻。
I often read news on Sohu.
搜狐是一家互联网公司。
Sohu is an internet company.
use: Company name.

ex: 这里有众多的游客。
There are numerous tourists here.
中国人口众多。
China has a huge population.
use: Formal; 很多 is the everyday word.

ex: 年底我要回家。
I'm going home at the end of the year.
工作必须在年底以前完成。
The work must be finished before the end of the year.
use: Similarly 月底 (end of the month).

ex: 博物馆里有很多文物。
There are many cultural relics in the museum.
这件文物有两千多年的历史。
This relic is over two thousand years old.
use: Measure word 件.

ex: 我们在网上宣传这个活动。
We're publicising this event online.
这只是一种宣传，不一定是真的。
This is just publicity; it isn't necessarily true.
use: Can be neutral (promotion) or mean "propaganda".

ex: 这些都是日常用品。
These are all everyday items.
她的日常生活很简单。
Her daily life is very simple.
use: Before nouns: 日常生活, 日常工作.

ex: 我弟弟在上高中。
My younger brother is in high school.
我们是高中同学。
We were classmates in high school.
use: Short for 高级中学; 初中 is junior high.

m: **Orders** a **person** to feel something: **makes one** (sad, happy...).
ex: 这个消息令人高兴。
This news is cheering.
他的表现令人吃惊。
His performance was astonishing.
use: Formal; followed by a feeling: 令人满意, 令人失望. Spoken: 让人.

ex: 我们的老师很严格。
Our teacher is very strict.
公司对安全有严格的要求。
The company has strict safety requirements.
use: Goes with 要求, 规定, 管理; also as adverb: 严格遵守.

ex: 不管多晚，我都等你。
No matter how late it is, I'll wait for you.
这件事你别不管啊！
Don't just ignore this matter!
use: Paired with 都 or 也; spoken equal of 无论.

m: The **person** at the **neck** who **guides** others: a **leader**.
ex: 两国领导人见了面。
The leaders of the two countries met.
他是这个组织的领导人。
He is the leader of this organisation.
use: Mostly political leaders; 领导 is a boss at work.

ex: 他对现在的生活很满足。
He is content with his present life.
我们会尽量满足你的要求。
We'll do our best to meet your requirements.
use: 满足 + 要求 / 需要 (meet needs); 满意 is "pleased with".

ex: 科技推动社会发展。
Technology drives social development.
他推动了这项改革。
He pushed this reform forward.
use: Formal; often with 发展, 改革, 合作.

ex: 我下午有课。
I have class in the afternoon.
明天下午三点我们在门口见。
Let's meet at the entrance at three tomorrow afternoon.
use: Opposite 上午 (morning).

ex: 车停在地下停车场。
The car is in the underground car park.
这座城市有很长的地下铁路。
This city has a long underground railway.
use: 地下 (dì xià); also "secret": 地下工作.

ex: 昨天我去了超市。
I went to the supermarket yesterday.
昨天的作业你做完了吗？
Have you finished yesterday's homework?
use: Time words go before the verb, often at the start of the sentence.

ex: 你先走，我随后就到。
You go first, I'll be right behind you.
他吃完饭，随后就出去了。
He finished eating and went out right after.
use: More formal than 然后; often 随后就.

ex: 她学习很认真。
She studies very conscientiously.
请认真听我说。
Please listen to me carefully.
use: Also "take seriously": 你别认真，我开玩笑的。

ex: 请大声说。
Please speak up.
别在图书馆里大声说话。
Don't talk loudly in the library.
use: Before a verb: 大声说 / 大声叫. Opposite 小声.

m: A **person** who has **succeeded** in joining: a **member**.
ex: 我们家有五个成员。
There are five members in our family.
他是这个乐队的成员。
He is a member of this band.
use: 家庭成员 means "family member".

ex: 这座桥是明代修的。
This bridge was built in the Ming dynasty.
明代有很多有名的小说。
There were many famous novels in the Ming dynasty.
use: Same as 明朝 (1368–1644).

ex: 公司鼓励员工创新。
The company encourages its staff to innovate.
这个设计很有创新。
This design is very innovative.
use: Often 科技创新, 创新能力.

ex: 他不久就回来。
He'll be back soon.
毕业不久，她就找到了工作。
Not long after graduating, she found a job.
use: Often 不久以后, 不久就, or "…不久" (not long after…).

ex: 他的建议遭到了反对。
His suggestion met with opposition.
这个城市遭到了大雨的袭击。
The city was hit by heavy rain.
use: Only for bad things: 遭到批评, 遭到拒绝.

m: **Bank up earth** around a plant and **teach** it: **train**.
ex: 新员工要先培训一个月。
New staff must first be trained for a month.
我周末参加了一个电脑培训。
I attended a computer training course at the weekend.
use: 培训班 is a training class.

ex: 大雨持续了三天。
The heavy rain lasted three days.
经济持续发展。
The economy keeps on growing.
use: Often before a verb: 持续增长, 持续下降.

ex: 请写下这几个数字。
Please write down these numbers.
这个数字太大了，我不信。
That figure is too big, I don't believe it.
use: Also "digital": 数字电视.

ex: 周末公园里游客很多。
There are lots of visitors in the park at weekends.
很多外国游客来这里参观。
Many foreign tourists come here to visit.
use: Compare 旅客 (passenger) and 客人 (guest).

ex: 这种新药还在试验中。
This new drug is still being tested.
他们试验了很多次才成功。
They experimented many times before succeeding.
use: Close to 实验; 试验 stresses trying out something new.

ex: 那个时代，阶级很分明。
In that era, class lines were very clear.
他来自工人阶级家庭。
He comes from a working-class family.
use: Political and historical word.

ex: 他高兴得像孩子似的。
He was as happy as a child.
她好像什么都知道似的。
She acts as if she knows everything.
use: Comes at the end: 像…似的 / 好像…似的. 似 here is shì.

ex: 中国又发射了一颗卫星。
China has launched another satellite.
火箭明天早上发射。
The rocket will launch tomorrow morning.
use: For rockets, satellites, missiles, signals.

ex: 汉字是一种很古老的文字。
Chinese characters are a very ancient script.
这段文字写得很美。
This passage is beautifully written.
use: Also "text, writing" as opposed to pictures.

ex: 天门在湖北省。
Tianmen is in Hubei Province.
我的同学是天门人。
My classmate is from Tianmen.
use: Also means "gate of heaven" in stories.

m: A **tower** on the **city walls**: a **gate tower**.
ex: 我们爬上了城楼。
We climbed up the gate tower.
从城楼上可以看到整个城市。
From the gate tower you can see the whole city.
use: Famous one: 天安门城楼.

ex: 我们去公园散步吧。
Let's go for a walk in the park.
这个公园周末人很多。
This park is crowded at weekends.
use: Measure word 个 or 座.

ex: 空中飞着几只鸟。
A few birds are flying in the sky.
飞机在空中飞了十个小时。
The plane was in the air for ten hours.
use: Often 在空中; 空中小姐 is an air hostess.

ex: 你用什么软件学中文？
What app do you use to learn Chinese?
这个软件需要更新。
This software needs updating.
use: Opposite 硬件 (hardware); also used for apps.

ex: 这是事实，不是故事。
This is a fact, not a story.
事实上，他早就知道了。
In fact, he knew long ago.
use: 事实上 means "in fact".

ex: 我有早起的习惯。
I'm in the habit of getting up early.
你习惯这里的生活了吗？
Have you got used to life here?
use: 习惯 + verb/noun means "be used to": 习惯吃辣.

ex: 地球是圆的。
The Earth is round.
我们只有一个地球。
We only have one Earth.
use: The planet; ground or soil is 土地 / 地.

ex: 我只吃了一半。
I only ate half.
一半的学生都去过北京。
Half of the students have been to Beijing.
use: Can stand alone or before a noun; 一半…一半… "half… half…".

ex: 我刚刚到家。
I've just got home.
他刚刚还在这儿。
He was here just a moment ago.
use: Stronger than 刚; 刚刚 can also be a time noun: 刚刚他来了.

ex: 他手里拿着一本书。
He's holding a book in his hand.
决定权在你手里。
The decision is in your hands.
use: Also figurative: in someone's control.

ex: 这个国家有强大的武装力量。
This country has powerful armed forces.
他们用新武器武装了军队。
They armed the troops with new weapons.
use: Formal; 武装力量 means "armed forces".

ex: 他不但会说中文，还会写汉字。
He can not only speak Chinese but also write characters.
这家饭店不但便宜，而且好吃。
This restaurant is not only cheap but also tasty.
use: Paired with 而且 or 还 / 也 in the second part.

ex: 总统有权任免部长。
The president has the power to appoint and dismiss ministers.
这次任免名单已经公布了。
The list of appointments and dismissals has been published.
use: Formal, used in government news.

ex: 张居正是明代的大臣。
Zhang Juzheng was a Ming-dynasty minister.
张居正做了很多改革。
Zhang Juzheng carried out many reforms.
use: Famous reformer under the Wanli Emperor.

ex: 我今天不想出门。
I don't want to go out today.
我不想让你担心。
I don't want you to worry.
use: In old texts 不想 can mean "unexpectedly": 不想他竟来了.

ex: 我去过意大利。
I've been to Italy.
我很喜欢吃意大利面。
I love eating spaghetti.
use: Sound loan; 意大利人 is "Italian".

ex: 两个城市的距离是三百公里。
The distance between the two cities is 300 km.
距离考试只有三天了。
There are only three days left until the exam.
use: As a verb, "from": 距离…还有… "there's still … until".

ex: 我永远不会忘记你。
I will never forget you.
我们永远是好朋友。
We'll always be good friends.
use: 永远不 means "never".

ex: 这座寺是明朝年间建的。
This temple was built during the Ming dynasty.
康熙年间，这里很热闹。
In the Kangxi reign, this place was bustling.
use: Follows a reign or era name; historical.

ex: 我们应该互相帮助。
We should help each other.
他们互相看了一眼。
They glanced at each other.
use: Before a verb; similar to 相互.

ex: 他和妻子一起去旅游了。
He went travelling with his wife.
我妻子是老师。
My wife is a teacher.
use: 妻子 (qī zi) is "wife"; spoken words are 老婆 and 爱人.

ex: 妈妈，我回来了！
Mum, I'm home!
我妈妈做饭很好吃。
My mum's cooking is delicious.
use: Spoken; 母亲 is the formal word.

ex: 美丽的大海就在眼前。
The beautiful sea is right before our eyes.
眼前最重要的是找工作。
The most important thing right now is finding a job.
use: Also "for the moment": 眼前利益 (short-term gain).

m: The **first** **year**: year **one** of a reign or era.
ex: 这一年是新时代的元年。
This year is the first year of a new era.
这件事发生在乾隆元年。
This happened in the first year of the Qianlong reign.
use: Also used loosely: "year one" of a new trend.

m: What you **face**, like an **elephant**: the **target**; a **partner**.
ex: 你有对象了吗？
Do you have a boyfriend or girlfriend?
这本书的读者对象是小学生。
This book's target readers are primary school pupils.
use: Spoken 找对象 means "look for a partner".

ex: 你听见了吗？有人在叫你。
Did you hear? Someone is calling you.
我没听见你说什么。
I didn't hear what you said.
use: Result of listening; 听 is "listen". Negative 没听见.

ex: 天气变得越来越冷了。
The weather is getting colder and colder.
他变得很爱说话。
He has become very talkative.
use: Followed by an adjective or phrase.

ex: 我彻底忘了这件事。
I completely forgot about this.
房间需要彻底打扫一下。
The room needs a thorough cleaning.
use: Often as an adverb: 彻底解决, 彻底改变.

m: When **the whole** thing **ends up** said: **after all**.
ex: 他毕竟还是个孩子。
After all, he's still a child.
别怪她了，她毕竟是第一次。
Don't blame her, it is her first time after all.
use: Gives a reason that should be remembered.

ex: 这个城市发展得很快速。
This city has developed very rapidly.
我们需要快速解决这个问题。
We need to solve this problem quickly.
use: More formal than 快; often 快速发展, 快速增长.

m: The **court** of **fresh** mornings: **Korea**, now usually **North Korea**.
ex: 朝鲜在中国的东边。
North Korea is to the east of China.
他会说朝鲜语。
He speaks Korean.
use: South Korea is 韩国; 朝鲜族 is an ethnic group in China.

ex: 失败是成功之母。
Failure is the mother of success.
这次考试我失败了。
I failed this exam.
use: Opposite 成功.

ex: 我临时有事，不能去了。
Something came up at the last minute, so I can't go.
他在这里找了一个临时工作。
He found a temporary job here.
use: Also "temporary": 临时工 (temp worker).

ex: 今年公司的利润很高。
The company's profits are high this year.
这个生意利润不大。
This business doesn't make much profit.
use: Business word; goes with 增加, 提高.

ex: 多数人都喜欢周末。
Most people like weekends.
会上多数人同意了这个计划。
At the meeting, the majority agreed to the plan.
use: Also 大多数; opposite 少数.

ex: 那时我还很小。
I was still very small then.
那时候，这里没有高楼。
At that time there were no tall buildings here.
use: Spoken form is 那时候.

ex: 你知道去机场的路线吗？
Do you know the route to the airport?
我们换一条路线吧。
Let's take a different route.
use: Measure word 条; also "political line".

ex: 我吃一个，其余的给你。
I'll eat one, and the rest are for you.
其余的人都已经走了。
Everyone else has already left.
use: Often 其余的 + noun.

ex: 学生被划分成三个组。
The students were divided into three groups.
这个城市划分为五个区。
This city is divided into five districts.
use: Often 划分为 / 划分成.

ex: 他是我唯一的朋友。
He's my only friend.
这是唯一的办法。
This is the only way.
use: Before a noun with 的.

m: A **flat** machine that **is able** to roll on: a **tank**.
ex: 路上开过来一辆坦克。
A tank came along the road.
博物馆里有一辆老坦克。
There's an old tank in the museum.
use: Sound loan of "tank"; measure word 辆.

m: **Still** in the **books**: a high **minister** in old China.
ex: 他被任命为礼部尚书。
He was appointed Minister of Rites.
尚书是古代很高的官。
A shangshu was a very high official in ancient times.
use: Historical; 尚书 is also the "Book of Documents".

ex: 我对这个词没有概念。
I have no idea what this word means.
这个概念很难理解。
This concept is hard to understand.
use: 没有概念 means "have no idea".

ex: 这条消息的来源是哪里？
What's the source of this news?
农业是他们收入的主要来源。
Farming is their main source of income.
use: 收入来源 means "source of income".

ex: 房间里充满了阳光。
The room is full of sunshine.
她对未来充满信心。
She is full of confidence about the future.
use: Often 充满了 + noun; also for feelings.

ex: 商店降低了价格。
The shop lowered its prices.
多运动可以降低生病的机会。
Exercising more can reduce the chance of getting ill.
use: Transitive; compare 下降 (fall by itself).

m: The **four** **big** ones: the **four elements**, or any famous four.
ex: 你读过四大名著吗？
Have you read the Four Great Classical Novels?
中国古代有四大发明。
Ancient China had four great inventions.
use: Used before a noun to group four famous things.

ex: 你慢慢吃，别着急。
Take your time eating, don't rush.
天慢慢黑了。
It gradually got dark.
use: Often 慢慢地 or 慢慢来 (take your time).

ex: 公园里有很多老人在跳舞。
There are many old people dancing in the park.
我们应该照顾老人。
We should look after the elderly.
use: Polite form 老人家.

ex: 这个答案不符合要求。
This answer doesn't meet the requirements.
他的条件完全符合。
His qualifications fully match.
use: Goes with 要求, 条件, 标准, 事实.

m: A **meeting** to **send out** and **announce** news: a **press conference**.
ex: 公司下午开发布会。
The company is holding a press conference this afternoon.
很多记者参加了新手机的发布会。
Many reporters came to the launch of the new phone.
use: Measure word 场 or 个; also "product launch".

ex: 王小姐，你好！
Hello, Miss Wang!
这位小姐在找你。
This young lady is looking for you.
use: Polite with a surname; used alone it can sound rude in some places.

ex: 他在大学学哲学。
He studies philosophy at university.
这本书讲了很多人生哲学。
This book has a lot of philosophy of life.
use: 哲学家 is "philosopher".

ex: 她轻轻地关上了门。
She closed the door gently.
风轻轻地吹着。
The wind is blowing softly.
use: Usually 轻轻地 before a verb.

m: **North** at **peace**: **Beiping**, an old name of Beijing.
ex: 那时北京叫北平。
At that time Beijing was called Beiping.
他一九三零年来到北平。
He came to Beiping in 1930.
use: Used for Beijing in 1928–1949.

m: The **old** hand at the counter **board**: the **boss**.
ex: 老板，这个多少钱？
Boss, how much is this?
我们老板今天不在。
Our boss isn't in today.
use: Also a friendly way to call a shopkeeper.

ex: 他是我的大学同学。
He was my university classmate.
同学们，上课了！
Class, let's begin!
use: Teachers address the class as 同学们.

ex: 学校门口写着校名。
The school's name is written at the gate.
这所大学改过两次校名。
This university has changed its name twice.
use: Formal; school name.

ex: 这个省山地很多。
This province has a lot of mountainous land.
他骑山地车去上班。
He rides a mountain bike to work.
use: 山地车 means "mountain bike".

ex: 美军在那里有基地。
The US military has a base there.
美军已经离开了这个地区。
US forces have left this area.
use: 美 here is short for 美国.

ex: 我不喜欢那种颜色。
I don't like that kind of colour.
他不是那种人。
He's not that kind of person.
use: Before a noun; compare 这种 (this kind).

ex: 他率领球队赢了比赛。
He led the team to victory.
将军率领士兵过了河。
The general led his soldiers across the river.
use: Formal; leading a group of people.

m: A **room** to **take care of** **public** affairs: an **office**.
ex: 我在办公室等你。
I'll wait for you in the office.
老师的办公室在二楼。
The teacher's office is on the second floor.
use: Measure word 间 or 个.

m: **Record** your name and **take** you: **accept** an applicant.
ex: 她被北京大学录取了。
She was accepted by Peking University.
这次公司只录取了十个人。
The company only took on ten people this time.
use: Usually 被…录取; 录取通知书 is an admission letter.

ex: 这个地方矿产很丰富。
This place is rich in minerals.
他们靠矿产赚了很多钱。
They made a lot of money from minerals.
use: Mining-related, formal.

ex: 他当下就同意了。
He agreed on the spot.
我们要过好当下的生活。
We should live well in the present.
use: Modern use often "the here and now".

ex: 你还要别的吗？
Do you want anything else?
我们去别的地方看看吧。
Let's go and look somewhere else.
use: Before a noun, or alone: 别的呢?

ex: 有问题可以打电话咨询。
If you have questions, you can call to ask.
他去律师那里咨询了一下。
He went to consult a lawyer.
use: Common in 咨询台 (information desk), 咨询公司.

ex: 我属小龙。
I was born in the year of the Snake.
蛇年也叫小龙年。
The Year of the Snake is also called the Year of the Little Dragon.
use: Folk name for the snake sign; 亚洲四小龙 are the "Asian Tigers".

ex: 我要在北京住几天。
I'll stay in Beijing for a few days.
这几天你去哪儿了？
Where have you been these past few days?
use: As a question it means "how many days?": 你住几天？
